description: React component for AI chat interface, including message handling, streaming responses, UI controls, and integration with backend APIs.

methods.name: handleChatSubmit
methods.description: Handles user message submission, including validation, updating chat history, and triggering AI response.

methods.name: canScrollToBottom
methods.description: Determines if the chat view can scroll to the bottom based on current scroll position.

methods.name: scrollToBottom
methods.description: Scrolls the chat view to the bottom, with optional behavior (instant or smooth).

methods.name: completeAIChat
methods.description: Sends chat messages to backend API, handles streaming response, updates chat history, and manages UI state.

methods.name: handleRegenerate
methods.description: Re-generates a response for a specific message index, respecting user limits.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes a chat message at a specified index and updates backend.
